selection.coordinates: Normalized 0–1 after EXIF orientation and requested rotation; keyboard fields display percentages.

engineBehavior.paddleControls: Language and layout selects disabled; geometry and filters shared.
engineBehavior.availabilityHint: Explain missing installation/models without claiming model accuracy or verified inference.

fieldOutput.defaultApi: structured=true; seven fields and filtered summary. Raw OCR requires explicit technical structured=false.
fieldOutput.interaction: Edit only the seven fields. Failed extraction preserves corrections; successful extraction replaces all seven. No free-form zone append.
fieldOutput.summary: Read-only, filled retained fields only; copy/TXT use summary; JSON retains all seven field keys.
fieldOutput.evidence: Field-specific labels/candidates and positions, with no artificial confidence percentage.

narrative.overview: The existing paper and forest-green workbench now pairs source preparation with exactly seven editable retained fields. A serif introduction and system controls preserve the visual identity; a read-only filtered summary and field-specific notes support review without exposing full OCR text.

rules.name: Flat work surface
rules.body: Use tone and thin borders without shadows.

dos: Do keep extraction primary and copy/export secondary.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, clear disabled states and readable French instructions.
Do keep source and result adjacent on desktop and sequential on mobile.
Do preserve keyboard coordinate editing, field-specific evidence and corrections after failed reruns.
Do keep optional-engine availability and errors explicit, preserving prior text on failure.
Do keep the result surface and normal exports restricted to the seven fields; raw OCR belongs only to explicit technical compatibility mode.
donts: Don't introduce external font requests or decorative shadows into this local, flat interface.
Don't hide editing, copy or export behind an extra screen.
